description:
3000W Dual-Motor Electric Bike：TWO 1000W high speed brushless motors for adults providing electric bikes strong power and climbing capabilities, assists the speed up to 35MPH. 82Nm of torque fully satisfies your riding in all terrains. Equipped with shimano 21 speed gears, which offers more accurate and smoother gear shifting capability. It would be a nice choice for gaining a fasinating and wonderful cycling.

Large Capacity Electric Bicycles: Built-in 52V/ 30 Ah rechargeable Lithium-Ion battery, offers long riding range up to 40-68miles in pedal assist mode. The waterproof battery of electric bike is not only large capacity and long lasting, but it's also removable, convenient to take home or office for charging.

Fat Tire E Bikes: The 26'' *4.0'' fat tire with tread patterns has a wider contact area which enhances flexibility, excellent grip, wear resistance and anti-skid function to let you safer in rainy day ， The adult electric bicycles provide 3 working modes, Pure electric mode, pedal-assist mode, classic bike mode. You can comfortably ride on the beach, mountain, gravel, mud, puddles and other diverse terrain by using this fat tire electric bike.

Excellent Performance in 3 Riding Models:Pure electric mode(40-50km battery range); Pure manpower mode; Pedal assist mode(60-90km battery range); Customize your ride performance with 3 riding modes and Shimano 21-speed，you can enjoy cycling in each mode. Support 180kg(396LBS). Suitable height between 165cm (65in) and 195cm (77in). The perfect disc brakes and lighting system fully protect your safety. Better shock absorption effect will bring you the best riding experience.

Aluminum Frame & Fork: The frame is made from lightweight and solid 6061 aluminum alloy. Lockable aluminum front suspension fork can effectively absorb shocks during riding, helps you pass rough terrain with less effort

Smart Digital LCD Display: The Intelligent LCD display keeps track of real-time speed, battery level, pedal assist level and mileage. Mileage 5 Speed LCD display computer makes it better for you to know clearly about the per hour speed and the whole distance you have ridden, and also you can know the battery remaining capacity of your bike. You can have more choice for 5 speed mode than normal. This electric mountain bike also comes with a bright LED headlight, making you visible and safe at night

Easy to Assemble: This e-bike comes 85% pre-assembled. A video guide is available in the product page. Comes with a rear rack and mudguards

Professional Customer Service: 1-year warranty for battery, charger, motor and controller. If you run into any trouble with our bikes, pls contact us, we’ll reply your message within 24 hours. Pls keep the original bike box for 30 days for possible returns

【UPGRADE】：Electric bike upgrades are based on buyers' feedback and experience! We have upgraded the headlights of electric bicycles and upgraded the color screen instruments!
